actor.ash_monk.description: Switches stances and pays for tempo mistakes.
actor.ash_monk.name: Ash Monk
actor.bone_merchant.description: Buys progression with gold and suffers when poor, so nearly realistic.
actor.bone_merchant.name: Bone Merchant
actor.drone_cyborg.description: Creates up to three drones that trigger at end of turn or can be used manually.
actor.drone_cyborg.name: Drone Cyborg
actor.iron_confessor.description: Plays through block, weakness and slow pressure.
actor.iron_confessor.name: Iron Confessor
actor.masochist.description: One actor of the pair. Endures pain and turns it into leverage.
actor.masochist.name: Masochist
actor.plague_anatomist.description: Plays through poison, weakness and long fights.
actor.plague_anatomist.name: Plague Anatomist
actor.sadist.description: One actor of the pair. Pushes offense and risk.
actor.sadist.name: Sadist
actor.wanderer.description: A simple solo fighter without sharp rule changes.
actor.wanderer.name: Wanderer
archetype.ash_monk.details_description: The Ash Monk gains power through stance choices. Flame increases damage but increases incoming damage. Ash improves block but lowers damage. Smoke reduces incoming damage.
archetype.ash_monk.name: Ash Monk
archetype.ash_monk.short_description: Plays through Flame, Ash and Smoke stances.
archetype.ash_monk.strength.stances: Can change fight tempo through stances.
archetype.ash_monk.unique_mechanic: Only one stance can be active. Entering a new stance removes the old one. Flame: +25% outgoing damage and +25% incoming damage. Ash: +2 block from cards and -15% outgoing damage. Smoke: -25% incoming damage.
archetype.ash_monk.weakness.misstance: The wrong stance can punish a turn hard.
archetype.bone_merchant.details_descript: This archetype is built around economy. It starts with more gold and earns more money, but deck growth depends heavily on shops and special rest options.
archetype.bone_merchant.name: Bone Merchant
archetype.bone_merchant.short_descriptio: Gets new cards mostly through purchases.
archetype.bone_merchant.strength.rest_sh: At rest sites, will be able to buy 2 cards from 5 offered cards.
archetype.bone_merchant.unique_mechanic: Normal combats grant 25% more gold but no card rewards. At rest sites, this archetype will be able to open a five-card offer and buy two cards. Part of this behavior is already handled in rewards; the rest will attach through mechanic_id.
archetype.bone_merchant.weakness.no_card: Does not get normal post-combat card rewards.
archetype.bone_merchant.weakness.shop_de: Highly dependent on shops and economy.
archetype.drone_cyborg.details_descripti: The Cyborg creates striker, guardian and bomber drones. You start with 3 slots. If you summon a drone while full, the oldest drone is used automatically and frees its slot.
archetype.drone_cyborg.name: Drone Cyborg
archetype.drone_cyborg.short_description: Creates drones and manages three slots.
archetype.drone_cyborg.strength.end_turn: Can gain damage and block after setup without spending cards.
archetype.drone_cyborg.unique_mechanic: Drones: Striker deals 3 damage at end of turn. Guardian grants 4 block at end of turn. Bomber deals 8 damage to all enemies when used. Overflow uses the oldest drone.
archetype.drone_cyborg.weakness.slot_pre: Must manage three drone slots carefully.
archetype.iron_confessor.details_descrip: The Iron Confessor is stable, durable and strong when allowed to build defense. Poison, fire and fast-scaling enemies are more dangerous.
archetype.iron_confessor.name: Iron Confessor
archetype.iron_confessor.short_descripti: A slow defender who wins through block.
archetype.iron_confessor.unique_mechanic: Gains extra block from the starting relic and uses cards that defend while pressuring enemies.
archetype.iron_confessor.weakness.slow: Wins slowly and may let enemies scale.
archetype.plague_anatomist.details_descr: The Plague Anatomist has weaker direct damage but excels in long fights. Poison, weak and vulnerable turn enemies into paperwork with a bad ending.
archetype.plague_anatomist.name: Plague Anatomist
archetype.plague_anatomist.short_descrip: Kills slowly with poison and debuffs.
archetype.plague_anatomist.strength.debu: Can reduce incoming damage with weak.
archetype.plague_anatomist.strength.long: Strong in long fights and against bulky enemies.
archetype.plague_anatomist.unique_mechan: First system layer: this archetype starts with a poison identity relic and cards that apply poison, weak and vulnerable.
archetype.plague_anatomist.weakness.slow: Slow to ramp and weaker against fast aggression.
archetype.sadist_masochist.details_descr: This archetype creates a party with two separate actors. Each has their own health, energy, relic pool, and future statuses. No main/support split, just two bodies and twice the ways to cause trouble.
archetype.sadist_masochist.name: Sadist & Masochist
archetype.sadist_masochist.short_descrip: One selection, two separate combat actors.
archetype.sadist_masochist.strength.spli: Split resources create more tactical windows.
archetype.sadist_masochist.strength.two_: Two separate bodies allow more flexible threat distribution.
archetype.sadist_masochist.unique_mechan: Sadist and Masochist exist as two separate actors. Their resources and health are split. Later, cards and relics can target one of them or their interaction.
archetype.sadist_masochist.weakness.comp: Requires careful management of two actors.
archetype.sadist_masochist.weakness.low_: Each actor is individually more fragile than a normal hero.
archetype.wanderer.details_description: The Wanderer does not change the core rules. Regular energy, regular rewards, and a readable starting deck.
archetype.wanderer.name: Wanderer
archetype.wanderer.short_description: A basic archetype for the first proper run.
archetype.wanderer.strength.flexible: Flexible starting deck with no harsh weakness.
archetype.wanderer.unique_mechanic: No special mechanic. This archetype is a baseline for balance and onboarding.
archetype.wanderer.weakness.no_specializ: No strong specialization or explosive scaling.
